sources.label: LockStar Clock
sources.author: LockStar Clock
patch_list: Anchors the lock screen clock to the horizontal center of the screen. Your vertical position is kept. Re-save the clock in LockStar after installing.
Does nothing. Select only this patch to test whether a re-signed LockStar opens at all.
Alternative to 'Center lock screen clock': makes SystemUI use its stock (centered) clock position. Your vertical position is not kept. Enable only one of the two.
